premises.text: Complex traits involve many genes, and state-of-the-art GWAS returns mostly non-useful targets while breeding or GMO development takes many years and large cost
premises.evidence_span: The genome-wide association studies are our current state-of-the-art, but only about 14% of the things that they return are actually useful

premises.text: There is an urgent unmet need to deliver new resilient crop varieties to farmers in time
premises.evidence_span: We have an urgent and unmet need to deliver new and resilient crop varieties to farmers

premises.text: Avalo's interpretable-ML discovery plus AI cross-recommendation stack finds causal targets at high precision, needs far less data, and speeds discovery and development
premises.evidence_span: The result is a new discovery method that, instead of the 14% accuracy of GWAS, allows us to identify causal gene targets with 90% precision

premises.text: Efficiency lets Avalo work on any crop and place the technology in partners' breeding pipelines while also creating new seeds with partners and its own R&D
premises.evidence_span: we're working with a number of pilot partners to get our technology into their existing breeding pipelines
